tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i rgyun gyi nyams len bya ba'i rim pa thugs kyi thig le zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// mi rtog rdo rjes dngos 'dzin 'jig /gzhon nu snying rje'i mtshon chen thogs// zung du 'jug la phyag byas nas// rgyun gyi nyams len mdor bsdus 'chad// bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu yi dam du byed cing mngon rtogs yongs rdzogs bsgom par mi lcogs pa dag gis phyag rgya gcig pa la rnal 'byor du bya ba'i rim pa ni 'di yin te/ thog mar/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal// dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo// mchog gsum bsten pa'i zhing gyur la// gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi// dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i// dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol// dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i gegs// nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi// phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos// ma chags spyod la rjes yi rangs// dag pa'i mtha' bzhi dri ma med// rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do// bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' la// dgos pa gsum gyi lus 'bul lo// tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i las rnams kun// bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo// zhes rgyun bshags dang*/ sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal kun dang bral bar shog /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing*// chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs par shog /ces tshad med bsgom/ hūm̐/ rdo rje khros pas zhe sdang gcod// mtshon chen sngon po cher 'bar ba// nam mkha'i dkyil du thig le shar// srog gi sgo ru shar ba na// snying gi go ru bsgom par bya// oṃ ma hā shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ rang bzhin ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams byang chub la dgod par bya'o// stong nyid snying rje zung du 'jug pa'i rang sems hūm̐ yig mthing nag nam mkha'i khams su gnas par gyur/

oṃ dharmā dhā tu swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3haṃ/ nam mkha'i hūm̐ las spros pa'i ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis snod bcud thams cad sbyangs/ e yam̐ ram̐ bam̐ lam̐ ram̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐ rnams spros pa las rten gyi dkyil 'khor grub pa ni/ e yig nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus su yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ bam̐ las chu/ lam̐ las dkyil 'khor rnams brtsegs pa'i steng du ram̐ las rak+ta'i rgya mtsho/ de'i dbus su keṃ las keng rus brtsegs pa'i ri rab/ bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe ban+dha dz+nyā na tsakra maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ bh+rūm̐/ ri rab kyi steng du bh+rūm̐ las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan pa rab tu 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba'i dbus su gru gsum mthing nag mu khyud rdo rjes spras pa/ de'i steng du pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ gis sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ gis zla ba'i gdan/ ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ gis nyi ma'i gdan/ shaṃ ru drwa ru dri ti ra bam̐ gyis ru drwa pho mo g.yas g.yon du mgo bstan te 'gyel ba'i gdan rnams su gyur/ nam mkhar gnas pa'i rang sems hūm̐ yig de gzhal med khang gi dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du babs pa las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa thams cad mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ khyad par du gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān bam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal chen po he ru ka khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje gzhon nu'i skur gyur pa ni/ dus mtha'i sprin ltar sku mdog nag /dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad// rab khros shin tu 'jigs pa'i sku// sku che rags shing sbom la thung*// g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal// dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum g.yo// zhal gdangs mche gtsigs ljags kyang 'gril// g.yas pa'i phyag gi dang po ni// rdo rje rtse dgu 'phyar zhing gsor// gnyis pas rdo rje rtse lnga bsnams// g.yon gyi dang po sdigs mdzub can// me dpung bsnams pas gdug can sreg

/gnyis pas mdung rtse gsum pa yis// rtse mor mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /tha ma mdun gyi phyag gnyis kyis// ri rab phur bu bsgril ba'i tshul// zhabs bzhi g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs pas// ru drwa pho mo mnan cing brdzis// stag gi pags pa'i smad dkris can// glang lpags zhing chen stod g.yogs gsol// thod pa tshar gsum phreng bas brgyan// gdug pa'i sbrul gyis brgyan pa ste// rgyal rigs dkar po thod du bcings// rje rigs ser pos mgul rgyan can// dmangs rig dmar po snyan char byas// bram ze ljang gu gdu bu ste// ske rags dang ni se mo do// klu chen gdol pa nag po'o// thal chen mchog gi tshom bu dang*// rak+ta dmar gyi thig le dang*// zhag chen zo ris rnams kyis mtshan// sma ra smin ma me ltar 'bar// dbu skra khams ser gyen du 'khyil// rdo rje'i gshog pa g.yas g.yon gdengs// sku lus rdo rjes go char gtams// ye shes me phung dbus na bzhugs// phung po khams dang skye mched dang*// skra dang ba spu'i khung bu sogs// thams cad rdo rje gzhon nus gtams// thugs kar sor bzhi'i tshad tsam gyi// gzhal med khang pa sgo gcig pa// sgo srung rta mgrin rig mar bcas// de nang nyi ma la gnas pa'i// ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kar hūm̐// mtha' skor sngags phreng 'khod par gyur// oṃ dīp+ta tsakra ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma// mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi// g.yas pas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin// g.yon pas thod khrag yab la stob// khro mo'i cha byad yongs rdzogs pa// dpal chen sku la gnyis med 'khyud// thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' dang*// ting 'dzin sems dpa' a yig go /hūm̐/ snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni// bsad cing mnan pa ma yin te// phung po rdo rjer gtams byas nas// rnam par shes pa rdo rjer bsgom// rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros// hūm̐/

snod bcud thams cad rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ hūm̐/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin rnams// srid pa rdo rjer grub mdzod cig /yang hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa'i lha tshogs oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hūm̐/ srid pa rdo rje phur pa'i lha// ye shes khro bo grub par mdzod// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rnam par spyan drangs gnas gsum du thim/ hūm̐/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku// rang nyid rdo rje chos dbyings las// 'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa// sku yi dbyig tu bdag bskyed cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wāka badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha thams cad spyan drangs mdun du bzhugs par gyur/ hūm̐/ thabs kyi spyod pas 'gro don du// byams dang snying rjes gang 'dul ba// sangs rgyas phrin las rdzogs mdzad pa'i// dbang dang byin rlabs bdag stsol cig /rigs lnga rnams kyis dbang bskur bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra shrī he ru ka badz+ra kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐/ oṃ bud+dha shrī he ru ka bud+dha kro dhī shwa rī oṃ/ oṃ rat+na shrī he ru ka rat+na kro dhī shwa rī trām̐/ oṃ pad+ma shrī he ru ka pad+ma kro dhī shwa rī hrīḥ oṃ karma shrī he ru ka karma kro dhī shwa rī āḥ zhes pas bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor la dkyil 'khor rnam gsum rdzogs pa nyid du bsgom/ hūm̐ badz+ra dz+nyā na kī li kī la ya dz+nyā na satwa e tri ko na bi mā naḥ pam̐ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la/ ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la/ hūm̐ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān ban+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas 'dzab khang phyes la/

bcom ldan yab yum thabs shes gnyis su med// rnam sprul khro bo yab yum pho nya'i tshogs// yun ring dus nas bsnyen cing bsgrubs pa'i lha// drag po rang byung dbang dang dngos grub stsol// ces gsol ba gdab/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la kī la ya 'bru bcu drug pa ci nus su bzlas la/ mthar phreng ba bcas la thal mo sbyar te/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi sgo nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib bgegs dang bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang*/ tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas la/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ mdun gyi ye shes sems dpa' 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas rang nyid bkrag mdangs gzi brjid nus mthu phun sum tshogs par gyur/ ye shes lnga ldan sogs sam/ lha tshogs 'khor bcas ma lus kun// sngon gyi dam tshig rjes dgongs la// gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba dang*// kī la ya yi dngos grub stsol// zhes pa tsam gyis dngos grub zhu/ he ru ka'i yig brgya brjod/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ku mā ra kro dha rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kā wā tsi hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces go bgo /dge 'dis mtha' yas sems can kun// rdo rje gzhon nu kī la ya'i// go 'phang byang chub myur thob nas// bdud las rnam par rgyal bar shog /ces sogs smon lam gdab cing*/ hūm̐/ skye med chos sku'i rang bzhin rnam dag las// thugs dam dbang gis gzugs kyi sku sprul pa// bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku// mi 'gyur rtag pa'i don gyi bkra shis shog

/ces shis pa brjod la/ rjes thob kyi snang grags rtog gsum dpal chen po'i sku gsung thugs ye shes gnyug ma'i 'khor lo lam du khyer bas 'khrul mtshan yongs grol chen por la bzla bar bya'o// zhes pa 'di'ang rje btsun chen po'i gsung rab kyi zhabs tog dang*/ nyams len mkhan rnams la phan pa'i lhag blos pad+ma gar dbang rtsal gyis nag zla'i tshes bco lngar dpal spungs yang khrod du bris pa dge legs 'phel// ༈ /rdo rje phur pa'i 'khon lugs kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bai ḍūr+ya'i phreng mdzes zhes bya ba bzhugs so// khyab bdag gdod ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang*// dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i gsang 'dzin rdo rje sems// rgyal kun spyi gzugs pad+ma thod phreng la// gsol ba 'debs so dbang dang dngos grub stsol// klu dbang srung ba rdo rje rin chen dang*// shes rab yon tan tshul khrims rgyal po'i zhabs// rdo rje gtsug tor dge skyabs dge mthong la// gsol ba 'debs so dbang dang dngos grub stsol// shāka blo shes rab tshul khrims dkon mchog rgyal// sa chen kun snying rje btsun bsod nams rtse// grags pa rgyal mtshan sa skya paṇa chen la// gsol ba= /chos rgyal 'phags pa 'od ldan kun rdor zhabs// legs pa'i blo gros kun bsod rin rgyal mtshan// dpal ldan bla ma bla chen kun rgyal la// gsol ba= /theg chen chos rje rnam rgyal rgya gar ba// sa lo 'jam rdor sngags 'chang kun rin rje// bsod nams dbang po grags pa blo gros la// gsol ba= /kun dga' bsod nams puṇ+ya shwa ra dang*// kun dga' bkra shis bsod nams rin chen zhabs// kun dga' blo gros dpal ldan chos skyong la// gsol ba= /kun dga' rin chen 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang*// smin grol mdzod 'dzin rtsa ba'i bla ma ste// stod las mchog sgrub dbang bzhi'i brgyud pa la// gsol ba 'debs so dbang dang dngos grub stsol// yongs rdzogs bstan 'dzin bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhabs// shes rab rdo rje thugs rje shes rab dang*// dharmā kīr+t+ti nam mkha'i snying po la// gsol ba 'debs so mngon spyod mthar phyin shog

/shes rab rgyal mtshan kun dga' bsod nams mchog /ngag dbang chos grags sngags 'chang chen po dang*// bsod nams dbang po kun dga' don grub la// gsol ba 'debs so mngon spyod mthar phyin shog /kun bsod bsod nams dbang phyug kun bkras rje// dkon mchog rgyal po bsod nams rin chen sogs// smad las drag po sgrol dbang brgyud pa la// gsol ba 'debs so mngon spyod mthar phyin shog /dpal ldan tshul khrims ngor chen yab sras dang*// ma ti paṇa chen rdo rje gdan pa sogs// dbang lung srol 'dzin ngo mtshar brgyud pa la// gsol ba 'debs so phrin las lhun grub shog /rnam gsum brgyud pa'i chu bo ma lus pa// gcig bsdus gsang ba'i rgya mtsho rin chen mdzod// sgrol ba'i mgon po brgyud par bcas pa la// gsol ba 'debs so bdud las rnam rgyal shog /rnam gsum ting nge 'dzin la legs gnas nas// dkyil 'khor gsum bsgom mchod pa gsum gyis mchod// dri ma gsum sbyang sku gsum mngon gyur te// mchog sgrub lam nas don gnyis mthar phyin shog /rdzong 'phrang srog gi gnad la byang chub cing*// gsal ba gsum dang gdings gsum goms pa yis// mtshan ma'i dgra bgegs bdag tu 'dzin bcas pa// thal 'byin dgongs pas mngon spyod mthar phyin shog /rtsa brgyud bla mas rtag tu byin rlob cing*// lhag pa'i lha yis grub gnyis myur du stsal// mkha' 'gro dam can phrin las sgrub mdzad nas// kī la ya yi dngos grub myur thob shog /ces pa 'di'ang kī la ya'i lta dgongs la mos pa lam du byed pa pad+ma gar dbang bde ba'i rdo rjes/ rje btsun sgrol ba'i mgon pos bdud bzhi mtha' dag bcom nas 'od gsal mkha' khyab la mngon par byang chub pa'i dus chen dbo zla'i dmar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gsum par dpal spungs yang khrod du bris pa dge legs 'phel// ༈ /'khon lugs rdo rje phur pa'i gtor dbang gi yi ge byin rlabs bcud kyi thigs pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// snying rje khros pas zhe sdang gi// gdug can thal 'byin he ru ka

/phrin las rigs mchog la btud nas// smin byed snying po'i don gsal bya// gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi rgyud gzhung rnams su gtor ma la shes pa bzhi'am drug ldan dang phrin las rab 'byams gtor ma la brten nas sgrub pa'i tshul rgya cher gsungs pa'i nang tshan/ dbang dus gtor ma lhar shes pas smin byed thams cad kyi sna 'dren cing mjug sdud pa dang*/ gtor ma'i dbang ni dbang bskur thams cad kyi snying por gsungs pa ltar/ 'dir yang stod smad kyi dbang bskur rdzogs par ma thob pa la byin rlabs sgo 'byed dang bskyed bzlas kyi snod du rung ba'i phyir/ drag po sgrol dbang gi mtha' rten du 'byung ba nyid khol phyung du bya bar spro na/ stegs bu'i steng du khri'u la gtor ma stod zur gsum smad zlum pa mtheb kyus bskor ba dkar thig dmar gur can la sku tsaka dang dar gdugs mthing gas brgyan pa bsham/ de'i g.yas g.yon du thod pa sman rag gi bcud ldan/ mdun du chu gnyis nyer spyod kyi mchod pa'i phreng ba bsham/ slob dpon gyis bla ma dam pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa'am/ sa lo chen pos mdzad pa'i bsnyen sgrub gsal byed bdud rtsi'i 'od can gang rung ngam/ bsdu na rgyun khyer phyag rgya gcig pas kyang rung la/ gang ltar skyabs sems nas brtsams/ bskyed bstim sogs dang bzlas pa'i bar bdag mdun dbyer med du byas la bzlas pa bsdus te/ rang nyid gtso bo las bye ba'i gtso bo gnyis par gyur par mos/ sngon du mchod bstod ma song na skabs 'dir mdor bsdus bya/ de nas slob ma rnams sgo'i phyi rol tu khrus bya/ nang du 'ong ba dang slob dpon gyis kī la ya'i drag sngags brjod cing rol mo yungs thun gu gul bdugs la bgegs bskrad/ maṇ+ḍal bkye bsdu bya/ sems bskyed gsal btab la/ de la 'dir snga 'gyur bka' ma'i chos sde yo ga rnam pa gsum gyi nang tshan tan+t+ra chen po sde bco brgyad kyi bye brag

phur pa rol pa'i rgyud sde rnams la brten nas sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyis sgrub thabs rgyas bsdus mtha' yas pa mdzad nas/ bod yul gyi ljongs su chos rgyal yab sras gtso bor gyur pa'i rje 'bangs so so'i thugs dam gyi skal par stsal zhing grub pa'i 'bras bu mngon du gyur/ de dag gi dbon sras rig 'dzin rtsal 'chang bar ma chad pa las byon pa'i bka' srol du ma zhig mchis pa rnams kyi nang nas nyi zla ltar grags pa/ 'khon klu'i dbang po'i thugs dam/ 'khon ston grub pa'i dbang po da lta'i bar du zam ma chad pa'i rgyun las byon pas byin rlabs kyi gzi byin dang phrin las bka' babs kun las khyad par du 'phags shing 'gran zla dang bral ba 'di nyid la brten pa'i smin byed kyi snying po gtor ma'i dbang bskur bsgrub par bgyi ba la sogs kyis mtshams sbyar nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug thal mo me tog dang bcas te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ slob dpon dam pa dgongs su gsol// rdo rje gzhon nu'i dbang bskur ba// sems can kun la phan gdags phyir// de ring bdag la stsal du gsol// lan gsum/ rgyud rnam par dag par bya ba'i phyir/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje gzhon nu la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs sprin gtibs pa lta bus bskor te bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su 'gro ba la sogs pa'i yan lag brgyad tshul bzhin du bgyi bar mos pas rgyun bshags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gsung bar zhu/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal// dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo// mchog gsum bsten pa'i zhing gyur la// gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi// dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i// dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol// dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i gegs// nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi// phyogs bcu'i 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos// ma chags spyod la rjes yi rangs// dag pa mtha' bzhi dri ma med// rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do// bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' la// dgos pa gsum gyi lus 'bul lo// tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i las rnams kun// bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo// lan gsum/

de nas byin rlabs kyi gzhi 'god cing ye shes pa dbab pa la lus drang por bsrang zhing yid gzhan du ma yengs par dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon gyis/ oṃ ma hā shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pa'i rkyen gyis khyed rang rnams 'dug gnas dang phung khams skye mched thams cad mi dmigs te stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pa'i rkyen gyis/ pad+ma nyi ma zla ba dbang phyug pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ khyed rang rnams skad cig tsam gyis rdo rje gzhon nu sku mdog mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ zhal g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing ga phyag drug gi g.yas dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje rtse dgu pa dang rtse lnga/ g.yon dang po gnyis kyis me phung 'bar ba dang rtse gsum bsnams pa/ tha ma gnyis kyis ri rab kyi phur bu 'dril zhing dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa'i pang na yum 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma sngon mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon thod khrag rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can re gsal lam ste byung ba'i mos pa mdzod/ rang gi snying gar hūm̐ yig sngags kyi phreng ba me 'od rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas pa 'khod par gyur/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer ma mchis pa'i thugs ka nas rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dpag tu med pa sprul zhing spros/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ ba spu'i bu ga nas zhugs/ snying ga'i sa bon sngags bcas la thim/ sdig sgrib dag sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ lus nang thams cad 'od kyis gang bar gyur/ 'bru bcu drug pa'i sngags kyi mthar/

oṃ badz+ra a be sha ya a a a/ zhes lan grangs ci nus brjod/ gu gul sogs 'bebs pa'i rdzas bdug cing rol mo'i sgra bya'o// de ltar dbab pa'i ye shes pa sgo gsum dang dbyer mi phyed par brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rdo rje mgor bzhag la/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes brjod/ de nas dpal gyi gtor chen thogs la/ gtor ma 'di nyid dur khrod chen po'i klong dkyil ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus su pad+ma nyi ma zla ba dbang phyug pho mo bsnol ba'i steng du bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu sku mdog mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa yum 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i skur gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po las sku dang yig 'bru phyag mtshan 'od zer dkar po'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi dpral bar thim pas lus kyi sdig sgrib nad gdon bar du gcod pa thams cad bsal/ sku'i dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub ma lus pa thob byung snyam pa'i mos 'dun mdzod cig hūm̐/ thabs kyi spyod pas 'gro don du// byams dang snying rjes gang 'dul ba// sangs rgyas phrin las rdzogs par mdzod// dbang dang dngos grub 'dir stsol cig /oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ kā ya a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ zhes gtor ma spyi bor bzhag yang gtor ma dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum dngos su gsal ba'i mgrin pa'i āḥdamar po las sku dang yig 'bru phyag mtshan 'od zer dmar po'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par thim pas ngag gi sdig sgrib nad gdon bar du gcod pa thams cad bsal/ gsung gi dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub ma lus pa thob byung snyam pa'i mos 'dun mdzod cig hūm̐/ thabs kyi spyod pas sh+lo ka dang*/ sngags gong ltar gyi sham du/ wāka a bhi ṣiñca āḥ zhes mgrin par bzhag yang gtor ma dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum dngos su gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ sngon po las sku dang yig 'bru phyag mtshan 'od zer sngon po'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/

khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim pas yid kyi sdig sgrib nad gdon bar du gcod pa thams cad bsal/ thugs kyi dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub ma lus pa thob byung snyam pa'i mos 'dun rtse gcig tu mdzod/ tshigs bcad sngags bcas gong ltar la/ tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes snying gar bzhag yang gtor ma dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum dngos su gsal ba'i gnas gsum nas sku dang yig 'bru phyag mtshan 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du thim pas sgo gsum cha mnyam gyi sdig sgrib nad gdon bar du gcod pa thams cad bsal/ rdo rje gsum 'dus kyi dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub ma lus pa thob byung snyam pa'i mos 'dun rtse gcig tu mdzod/ tshigs bcad sngags bcas kyi mthar/ sarba a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ zhes gnas gsum du bzhag slar yang gtor ma bcom ldan 'das dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gtso 'khor sprul pa phyag brnyan dang bcas pa'i steng gi cha la rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma/ bar gyi cha la yi dam rgyud sde'i lha tshogs/ 'og gi cha la mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas te bzhugs pa/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor spyan drangs shing byin gyis brlabs pa la brten nas/ sku'i cha rnams nas khro chung mtshon cha me dpung gi tshogs 'phros pas nad gdon bar du gcod pa thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad cing bsal/ rdo rje bdud rtsi byin rlabs ye shes kyi chu rgyun dpag tu med pa byung zhing khyed rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang gang nas dbang bzhi rtsal rdzogs su thob/ dngos grub rnam pa gnyis stan thog gcig tu brnyes par mos shig hūm̐/ 'khor ba phur bu bsgrub don du// dbang dang byin rlabs zhu ba'i phyir// ye shes khro bo gshegs su gsol// ye shes khro bo gshegs nas kyang*// rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang*// phur pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol// ces dang*/

ye shes lnga ldan rigs lnga bde bar gshegs// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi// 'khor lo rab bskor zhi khro'i skur ston pa// thugs dam bzhin du 'di la brtser dgongs nas// drag po'i stobs kyis dgra bgegs bsgral ba dang*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol// zhes gtor ma spyi bor bzhag la/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phrin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i stobs gcig tu 'dus pa dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pas rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi sgo nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ nad gdon sdig sgrib bgegs dang bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang*/ tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*/ byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis rgyud la skyes nas myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub dpal chen po rdo rje gzhon nu'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces dang*/ snying po brjod/ mthar/ gtor ma'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos mdzod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mtha' rten bzlas pa'i lung sbyin pa'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon dang khyed rang rnams kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rdo rje sngon po nas 'bras tsam gyi lte bar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ yungs 'bru tsam gyi mthar kī la ya skra shad kyis bris pa lta bus bskor nas yod pa'i mos pa mdzod la/ slob dpon la gus 'dud drag po dung pa byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las/ sngags phreng mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byung*/

slob dpon gyi zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ snying ga'i hūm̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa la dang pos thim/ gnyis pas byin gyis brlabs/ gsum pas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod la/ sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum bar du mdzod/ kī la ya lan gsum/ de nas khyed rang rnams kyis slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// gsum/ slob dpon gyis me tog byin gyis brlabs nas/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs spyi ltar bya/ de nas me tog 'thor zhing shis brjod byas la rol mo bsgrag de ltar rdo rje phur pa'i bka' srol thams cad kyi nang nas rgyal mtshan gyi tog ltar mngon par mtho ba 'khon lugs grub brnyes rig 'dzin bar ma chad pa'i byin rlabs kyi rgyun gcig nas gcig tu byon pa gtor ma la brten pa'i smin byed zab mo bzlas lung dang bcas pa legs par grub pa yin pas sogs kyis mtshams sbyar la dam tshig khas len/ gtang rag dge bsngo sogs spyi ltar byas pas 'grub la/ cho ga'i rjes kyi bya ba'ang phrin las gang la brten pa de ltar bya ba yin no// 'bar ba chen po'i byin rlabs nyin byed kyis// bar chad dam sri'i mun khang rtsad nas bcom// bstan 'gro'i dge legs pad mtsho rgyas pa yis// sa gsum kun dgar byed pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa 'di'ang dpal he ru ka dang rnam dbyer ma mchis pa khyab bdag bla ma 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i bka' lung nor bu'i rgyal po byi dor bya ba'i blos/ ku sā li gu ṇa'i ming can blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes/ rtsa ba'i rgyud dang 'khon lugs drag po sgrol dbang sogs la rtsa ba tsam byung ba'i lus bzang la smin byed spyi 'gro'i cho ga'i lang tshos rnam par spras te dpal chen rol pa'i pho brang ga la bar skal ldan kun dga'i dga' ston du bgyis pa dge legs 'phel//

༈ /yang phur thun mong gi khrid yig a ti'i lam rim thar pa'i sgo gcig ces bya ba bzhugs// na mo gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī/ yod ces bya ba rtag par lta// med ces bya ba chad par lta// de phyir yod dang med pa las// 'das par ston mdzad bla mar 'dud// ces mchod par brjod nas/ 'dir rdzogs pa chen po a ti'i zhal gyi gdams pa rnams brjed pas 'jigs nas yi ger bris ba la/ chos bdag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dgyes shing gnang du gsol/ dang por chos nyid mngon su nyams su len pa'i dus/ thog mar skyabs sems sngon du song bas/ rang yi dam phur par gsal gdab pa'am/ gzhan yang yi dam gang yang rung bar gsal btab la/ tho rangs gnyid sogs ngoms par byas nas/ lus gnad drang por bsrangs pa'i skyil krung ngam/ me thab drug chings la g.yon pa'i mthe bong gung mo srin lag gsum pas bcing dam drags pa min pa'i 'ching ba byas pa'i ngos/ 'jam rlung g.yas g.yon dbus gsum nas bum pas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad phyir sangs sangs kyis don par bsam/ tshur rngubs dus bla ma yi dam thams cad kyi thugs rje byin rlabs rnams 'od zer gyi rnam par rang la thim par bsgom/ de nas 'og rlung cung zad 'then te steng rlung mnan/ mig gyen du log par byas nas smin mtshams kyi thad sor bzhi tsam gyi thad du mig bltas pas/ thog mar phyi dbyings nam mkha' skya wal gyis 'char/ nang dbyings nag po lhung bzed kha sbubs pa lta bu zhig 'char/ gsang dbyings 'od mthing ga zhig 'char ro// yang mig na na mig g.yon pa'i zur du phab la blta/ mig la rang gi kha chu srin mdzub kyis byug yang kha ches kyang byug go /g.yon zur du thig le 'od lnga'i dkyil 'khor 'char/ bsdu ba'i tshe thig le mdzod spur bsdus pa la/ thig le kha

mthing*/ cig snying gi dkyil du 'bral med du bsgom pa gnad che'o// mngon sum gtan la phebs pa'i rtags su dgong mo gnyid la 'gro kha dang*/ zhogs pa gnyid sad 'phral la yang thig le rnams 'bral med du 'char zhing*/ de nas thig le'i dbus su sprul sku'i rnam pa'i sku rnams kyang dbu nas rim bzhin sku sked yan chad du snang la gzung yul du ma grub par snang ste res thig le gcig gi nang du sprul sku bye ba phrag brgya ma 'dres par so sor 'char/ res de rnams gcig tu bsdus nas 'char/ de rnams ni sprul sku'i zhing khams mthong ba yin no// de nas longs sku'i rnam pa 'char ba la/ sprul sku de'i dpral bar 'phred la ri mo dod pa dang*/ de nas shangs dang zhal gyi bar du ri mo dod pa dang*/ de nas sprul sku de rim gyis zhi khro'i rnam par gong bzhin 'char ba'o// de rnams ni longs sku'i zhing khams mthong ba'o// de nas zhi khro de rim bzhin khro bo'i sku 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba/ che ba ri rab tsam chung ba yungs 'bru tsam la zhal ras 'jigs shing rngams pa/ stag sham rnams la khrag dngos su thig ge yod pa'i rnam pa 'char ba'o// de rnams ni chos sku'i zhing khams mthong ba yin no// sprul sku'i zhal ras mthong nas 'ja' lus 'grub par the tshom med pa'o// khyad par lu gu rgyud 'char ba de'i dkyil du lta ba gnad yin cing*/ mun khri dang mun khang byas tshe sun nyams yong bas/ gla ba'i pags pa mnyen dul song ba'i phyi gos chen nag pos bstums pa'i mtha' 'dril byas la/ mig la gseng yod pa'i mig dar byas nas mig la bkab pas sngar bzhin nyams len byas na mtshan snang rnams 'char zhing*/ gal te ltag rtsa na ba dang*/ dbugs stod du 'tshangs pa sogs byung na lta stangs cung zad klod la dbugs so bar du dal bus btang zhing sems rang babs su bzhag pa dang*/ dzā ti dang mar bsres la ltag rtsar byugs pas khad kyis sel bar 'gyur ro// mi mang po yod pa'i sar yang rang gi nyams len gyi dran pa ma yengs par snying ga'i thig le mthing nag de 'bral med du bsgom zhing*/

rgyun du rig pa mig gi nang du hrig ge drangs la bsgoms pas/ rig pa gsal rig stong gsum nam mkha' dwangs pa lta bu la mdun gyi nam mkha' la thig le dbus mthing ga mtha' 'ja' tshon sna lnga 'phro ba dang bcas pa mthong ba ni chos sku thig le nyag gcig mthong ba yin pas/ 'ja' lus su 'grub cing sems skye med kyi don rtogs par 'gyur ro// zhes rdzogs pa chen po a ti'i zhal gyi gdams pa 'di gzhan la mi smra ba'i bka' rgya dang bcas/ dbu mdzad bsam gtan chos 'phel dang chos rje gwa pa gnyis la thob rgyal lta rtser pradz+nyā rasmis gnang ba'o// sarba dā maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
